stage_source:
extends SceneTree
## Matched, inert in-world pad views. No generated units or flight simulation.
## Run at --fixed-fps 15; encode the saved frames at 15 fps.
## --view=normal,mat-detail,concrete-detail,windsocks selects views.
## --smoke saves one frame per view; --output=DIR chooses the capture directory;
## --offscreen keeps the window off the desktop.
func _initialize() -> void: call_deferred("capture")
func capture() -> void:
	var output := OS.get_user_data_dir().path_join("playground-fixture")
	var frames := 30
	var selected := ""
	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if arg.begins_with("--output="): output=arg.get_slice("=",1)
		if arg == "--smoke": frames=1
		if arg.begins_with("--view="): selected=arg.get_slice("=",1)
	if "--offscreen" in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		# (a borderless window placed off the desktop: a minimized one never draws)
		DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_NO_FOCUS,true)
		DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_WINDOWED)
		DisplayServer.window_set_position(Vector2i(-12000,-12000))
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(output)
	var settings = root.get_node("Settings")
	settings.apply_preset("high",false)
	settings.v["mood"]="day"
	settings.v["perf"]=0
	root.size=Vector2i(960,540)
	DisplayServer.window_set_size(Vector2i(960,540))
	RenderingServer.render_loop_enabled=false
	Engine.time_scale=0.0
	var world = load("res://scripts/game/world.gd").new()
	world.settings={"seed":4,"mood":"day","scenario":"inert-playground-review","map_size":1024}
	root.add_child(world)
	current_scene=world
	world.set_physics_process(false)
	world.set_process(false)
	world.nav=load("res://scripts/game/nav.gd").new()
	world.nav.terrain=world.terrain
	world.time=8.0
	world.cam=load("res://scripts/game/rts_camera.gd").new()
	world.cam.world=world
	world.add_child(world.cam)
	world.cam.set_process(false)
	world.cam.edge_pan=false
	world.set_decor([
		["soft",Vector3.ZERO,0.0,Vector3(16,0,12)],
		["swing",Vector3(-4,0,3),0.0,null],
		["slide",Vector3(3.2,0,2.6),PI,null],
		["climber",Vector3(3.6,0,-2.4),0.0,null],
		["sandbox",Vector3(-3.8,0,-2.4),0.0,null],
		["seesaw",Vector3(0,0,0.2),PI*0.5,null],
		["roundabout",Vector3(0.2,0,-3.8),0.0,null],
		["spring_rider",Vector3(-1.3,0,3.6),PI*0.5,0],
		["spring_rider",Vector3(-0.1,0,3.3),PI*0.5,1],
		["spring_rider",Vector3(5.4,0,0.6),PI*0.5,2]
	],Rect2(-8,-6,16,12))
	world.terrain.tick(1<<30)
	assert(world.soldiers.is_empty() and world.vehicles.is_empty() and world.projectiles.is_empty())
	var views := [["normal",Vector3.ZERO,32.0,-48.0,0.45],["close",Vector3(0,0,0.6),20.0,-42.0,0.45]]
	if selected != "": views=views.filter(func(v): return v[0] in selected.split(","))
	var records := []
	var first_view := true
	for view in views:
		var camera=world.cam
		camera.focus_pos=view[1]
		camera.dist=view[2]
		camera.target_dist=view[2]
		camera.pitch_deg=view[3]
		camera.yaw=view[4]
		camera._apply()
		for i in (24 if first_view else 4): await process_frame
		RenderingServer.render_loop_enabled=true
		var probes=world.atmo.light_probes
		if first_view and probes != null and probes.quality>0:
			probes._base_drawn=false
			probes._requeue_all_bricks()
			print("PLAYGROUND_PROBE_WARMUP")
			for bake_frame in 512:
				await process_frame
				await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
				if bake_frame % 32 == 0: print("PLAYGROUND_PROBE_FRAME ",bake_frame)
				if probes._tile_queue.is_empty() and probes._brick_queue.is_empty() and probes._light_queue.is_empty() and probes._local_queue.is_empty(): break
			assert(probes._brick_queue.is_empty())
		first_view=false
		for i in 6: await process_frame
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		print("PLAYGROUND_VIEW_READY ",view[0])
		var dest: String=output+"/"+view[0]
		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(dest)
		for frame in frames:
			camera.yaw=float(view[4])+0.12*sin(TAU*frame/maxf(frames-1,1))
			camera._apply()
			await process_frame
			await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
			root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(dest+"/%04d.png"%frame)
			records.append({"view":view[0],"frame":frame,"focus":str(camera.focus_pos),"distance":camera.dist,"pitch":camera.pitch_deg,"yaw":camera.yaw,"world_time":world.time})
	FileAccess.open(output+"/capture.json",FileAccess.WRITE).store_string(JSON.stringify({"renderer":RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method(),"seed":4,"mood":"day","preset":"high","records":records,"fps":15,"fixture":"Small native scenery fixture using actual World terrain, Atmosphere, Decor and RTS camera. Flat terrain and ten decorative entries (three spring riders, which a build without them leaves out). No town generation, units or gameplay. Frozen daylight; camera orbit only."},"\t"))
	print("PLAYGROUND_CAPTURE_COMPLETE")
	quit()

settings.decor: Ten explicitly placed native Decor entries: soft surface, swing, slide, climber, sandbox, seesaw, roundabout and three spring riders. Same ordering and transforms on both revisions; main has no spring_rider kind, so draws nothing there.

runtime.display: Windows 11, borderless no-focus window placed off the desktop
runtime.timing: Fixed 15 fps steps; encoded 15 fps is camera playback, not a performance measure.

encoding: PIL: each 960x540 frame scaled to 800x450, before and after side by side under 35 px label bars (Segoe UI); JPEG frames piped to Playwright's ffmpeg n7.0.1: -f image2pipe -framerate 15 -c:v mjpeg -i pipe:0 -vf format=yuv420p -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 34 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 -g 60 -an. 1600x520, 60 frames, 4 s, silent. Poster: frame 45 (close camera).
limits: Small native scenery fixture, not full-town placement or gameplay coverage.
No grading, geometry substitutions or synthetic frames; side-by-side downscale and labels only.

validation.matched: All 60 camera/world-phase records exactly equal between main f48b0f43 and the branch 430e48ed.
validation.visual: Beginning, middle and end frames of both views inspected on both revisions; both completed without script errors.
validation.scope: Presentation of the decorative models only.
